Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

daimondstats 0.0.5

  • New season_games() turns an MLB Stats API regular-season schedule into one row per completed game. It filters on the coded status F, because postponed games also report an abstract state of “Final”.
  • New dataset reviewed_team_seasons: full 162-game seasons for the five scorecard teams (810 rows). Win totals match each team’s final record.
  • compare_personal_season() now runs on real games. The vignette adds a section placing the scored Twins game within the 2024 Twins season.
  • jsonlite added to Imports.
  • Added this pkgdown website.

daimondstats 0.0.4

  • New dataset reviewed_base_out: 188 offensive events with base-out states rebuilt from MLB game feeds. Every row’s outs, bases, and half-inning runs are checked against the feed.
  • New dataset run_expectancy_fangraphs: the published FanGraphs 24-state run expectancy matrix.
  • New plot_run_impact() draws total RE24 by player.
  • New vignette, “From scorecard to run value”.

daimondstats 0.0.3

  • New dataset reviewed_scorecards: 179 plate appearances from five team scorecards. Every player’s and team’s counting totals match official MLB box scores.
  • Revised documentation for all functions and datasets.

daimondstats 0.0.2

  • New compare_personal_season() compares a set of scored games with same-size samples from one team’s season, matched on home and away.
  • New calculate_run_impact() computes event-level RE24 from base-out transitions and a 24-state run expectancy matrix.
  • New dataset twins_scorecard_2024: 35 plays from one Twins game.

daimondstats 0.0.1

  • First version, with import_scorecards() and calculate_batting_stats().
  • Includes a small fictional demo dataset and base R tests.
